description: Turtlemint is an insurance technology platform trusted by advisors and consumers. 1.6Cr+ policies sold, 5L+ advisors, 42 insurers. Three pillars: (1) Turtlemint Consumer App—all insurance in one place, instant quotes for health, car, bike, life; policy tracking, claims support, renewal reminders. (2) TurtlemintPro—advisor app to sell insurance, mutual funds, loans; marketing tools, customer management, POSP training with 500+ videos. (3) Turtlefin—embedded insurance and SaaS for banks, NBFCs, insurers, e-commerce; APIs for digital product launch in under 30 days. Compare and buy insurance online. Technology trusted by advisors.
